s:niigata/sado-kinzan: View from a hillside path on Sado Island of the Doyu-no-Warito, a mountaintop split into two jagged peaks by centuries of open-cut gold mining: a deep V-shaped cleft of bare reddish-brown and grey rock rising above dense green forest, low clouds drifting, soft overcast summer light.
s:niigata/shukunegi: Eye-level view down a narrow stone-paved alley in the tiny fishing village of Shukunegi: tightly packed two-storey houses clad in dark weathered cedar boards, small wooden windows, a slim triangular boat-shaped house at a fork in the lane, potted plants, quiet overcast early summer morning.
s:niigata/kiyotsu-gorge: Inside the end chamber of the Kiyotsu Gorge tunnel: a shallow mirror-like pool on the floor reflects the tunnel opening, turning the view of the gorge's grey columnar cliffs and orange-red autumn trees into a perfect circle, polished stone walls, soft daylight from the opening, no people.
s:niigata/echigo-yuzawa: Elevated winter view over the hot spring town of Echigo-Yuzawa buried in deep snow: snow-laden rooftops of ryokan and low buildings, wisps of steam rising, ski slopes with lit lift lines on the white mountainsides behind, blue hour after snowfall with warm windows glowing.
s:niigata/hoshitoge: Dawn view from a hilltop over the Hoshitoge rice terraces in late spring: dozens of freshly flooded paddies of irregular curved shapes stepping down the slope, each reflecting a pink and pale blue sky, a thin sea of mist in the valley, beech forest framing the edges.
s:niigata/yahiko-jinja: Gravel approach lined with towering ancient cedars leading to the main hall of Yahiko Shrine, dark unpainted wooden pillars and a broad grey-green copper roof, forested Mount Yahiko rising directly behind, a few red maples at the edges, calm late-autumn morning light.
s:niigata/takada-park: Night view across the outer moat of Takada Castle Site Park in early April: thousands of illuminated cherry trees in full pale-pink bloom reflected in still dark water, rows of glowing paper lanterns along the bank, the reconstructed white three-storey turret lit softly in the background.
f:niigata/hegi-soba: Overhead shot of hegi soba: bite-sized bundles of glossy pale grey-green buckwheat noodles laid in neat wavy rows on a large square shallow wooden tray, small cups of dipping sauce, chopped green onion and yellow karashi mustard beside it, dark wood table, soft window light, shallow depth of field.
f:niigata/tare-katsudon: 45-degree view of a black lacquered bowl of Niigata tare katsudon: several thin golden pork cutlets glazed in glossy dark soy-based sauce laid over white rice, no egg, the bowl lid set to one side, a small dish of pickles, wooden counter, warm natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:niigata/nihonshu: Close view of a row of small white ceramic sake cups filled with clear, slightly golden sake on a light wooden tasting counter, a pale blue concentric ring at the bottom of one cup, unlabelled glass bottles softly blurred behind, cool natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:niigata/sasa-dango: Overhead shot of sasa dango on a bamboo tray: several dumplings wrapped in green bamboo leaves tied with thin rush string, one unwrapped to show a soft deep-green mugwort rice dumpling with a little dark red bean paste visible, light wooden table, natural daylight, shallow depth of field.
s:toyama/alpine-route-murodo: Road-level view along the Yuki-no-Otani snow corridor at Murodo in late April: sheer white walls of compacted snow over ten metres high on both sides, showing layered horizontal bands, a tour bus small in the distance, tiny distant walkers, deep blue sky and bright high-altitude sunlight.
s:toyama/kurobe-dam: View from the observation deck of the massive curved concrete arch of Kurobe Dam in summer: a powerful white jet of discharged water spraying into the gorge with a rainbow in the mist, an emerald reservoir behind, steep green mountains with lingering snow patches, bright sunny day.
s:toyama/kurobe-gorge: A small narrow-gauge train with open-sided passenger carriages crossing a red steel truss bridge high above the emerald Kurobe River, steep V-shaped gorge walls covered in red, orange and yellow autumn foliage, mist on upper slopes, late October daylight.
s:toyama/gokayama-ainokura: Elevated winter view of Ainokura village: about twenty steep A-frame thatched gassho-style farmhouses deep in snow, scattered on a small terraced clearing ringed by snowy cedar forest, warm light glowing from a few windows, gentle snowfall at blue hour.
s:toyama/toyama-glass-museum: Looking up through the atrium of the Toyama Glass Art Museum building: bands of pale cedar louvres climbing diagonally floor after floor around an open void, glass skylight above, white walls, clean modern lines, soft even daylight, a few small distant visitors on upper walkways.
s:toyama/kansui-park: Dusk view across the calm canal in Fugan Canal Kansui Park toward Tenmon Bridge, a footbridge spanning the water between two slender towers, softly lit and mirrored in the still surface, tree-lined banks and lawns, pink and orange sunset sky.
s:toyama/amaharashi: Cold clear winter morning on the Amaharashi Coast: a small rocky islet topped with a few twisted pine trees standing in calm Toyama Bay, and across the water the snow-covered Tateyama mountain range rising sharply into a pale blue sky, wisps of sea mist on the surface.
s:toyama/zuiryuji: Symmetrical view through the two-storey wooden main gate of Zuiryuji toward the Buddha hall with its distinctive grey lead-tiled roof, long covered wooden corridors enclosing a wide open courtyard on both sides, weathered natural timber, calm overcast light, no people.
f:toyama/shiroebi: 45-degree view of a shiroebi donburi: a heap of tiny peeled raw white shrimp, translucent with a faint pink tint, piled glistening over vinegared rice in a dark ceramic bowl, a dab of wasabi and a shiso leaf, small soy dish beside it, wooden counter, natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:toyama/masuzushi: Overhead shot of masu-zushi in its round bentwood box lined with green bamboo leaves, the leaves folded back to reveal a disc of bright pink cured trout over pressed vinegared rice, one wedge cut out like a cake, light wooden table, soft daylight, shallow depth of field.
f:toyama/toyama-black: 45-degree view of a bowl of Toyama black ramen: almost jet-black soy broth, thick noodles, slices of pork chashu, menma bamboo shoots and a mound of chopped green onion, heavily dusted with coarse black pepper, a small bowl of white rice beside it, warm counter light, shallow depth of field.
f:toyama/hotaruika: Overhead shot of boiled firefly squid: a dozen tiny plump squid with purplish-brown bodies and short tentacles arranged on a small blue-and-white ceramic plate, a spoonful of pale yellow vinegared miso sauce and a sprig of greens, wooden table, spring daylight, shallow depth of field.
s:ishikawa/kenrokuen: Early winter view across Kasumigaike Pond in Kenrokuen: the two-legged Kotoji stone lantern with one leg standing in the water, behind it large pines tied with conical yukitsuri rope supports radiating from tall poles, a light dusting of fresh snow, calm reflections, soft grey morning light.
s:ishikawa/kanazawa-castle: View across a wide lawn of the reconstructed Hishi-yagura turret and long Gojikken-nagaya storehouse of Kanazawa Castle on tall stone walls: white plaster walls, lower walls with black-and-white lattice tiles, pale grey lead-tiled roofs, cherry trees in full bloom in front, clear spring morning.
s:ishikawa/higashi-chaya: Eye-level view down the stone-paved main street of the Higashi Chaya District in early morning: rows of two-storey wooden teahouses with fine reddish-brown vertical lattice facades and dark tiled eaves, no crowds, soft diffused light, wet paving stones after light rain.
s:ishikawa/omicho-market: Inside a covered aisle of Omicho Market in winter: stalls piled with bright orange-red boiled snow crabs, whole fish laid on crushed ice, baskets of oysters and shellfish under warm hanging lamps, wet concrete floor, small distant shoppers.
s:ishikawa/21st-century-museum: Exterior of the 21st Century Museum of Contemporary Art in Kanazawa: a low circular building with continuous clear glass walls under a thin flat white roof, several white box volumes rising above the roofline, surrounded by a wide green lawn, clear blue summer sky.
s:ishikawa/nagamachi: Narrow stone-paved lane in the Nagamachi Samurai District in winter: tall ochre earthen walls topped with dark tiles and covered in protective straw mats, a small clear canal running alongside, light fresh snow on the tiles, quiet grey morning light, no people.
s:ishikawa/yamanaka-onsen: View from the riverside path in Kakusenkei Gorge of Korogi Bridge, a small roofed bridge of natural cypress wood spanning the rocky Daishoji River, surrounded by steep banks of red and orange autumn maples, moss-covered boulders, soft overcast light.
f:ishikawa/kaisendon: Overhead shot of a kaisendon in a black lacquer bowl: vinegared rice heaped with sweet shrimp, tuna, yellowtail, salmon roe, sea urchin, crab and white fish sashimi, a shiso leaf and wasabi, small soy dish beside it, wooden market counter, natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:ishikawa/jibuni: 45-degree view of jibuni in a red-and-black lacquered lidded bowl: slices of starch-coated duck in a thick glossy brown broth with a ridged slice of wheat gluten, shiitake mushroom and green vegetables, a small dab of wasabi on top, tatami-room table, soft natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:ishikawa/kanazawa-oden: 45-degree view of a shallow ceramic bowl of Kanazawa oden in pale golden broth: a small crab shell packed with crab meat and orange roe, a wheel-shaped slice of wheat gluten, a sea whelk and daikon radish, a dab of mustard, wooden counter, warm light, shallow depth of field.
f:ishikawa/kinpaku-soft: Close view of a soft-serve vanilla ice cream cone completely wrapped in a single shimmering sheet of thin gold leaf, the crinkled metallic surface catching the light, held against a softly blurred background of dark wooden lattice teahouse facades, daylight, shallow depth of field.
s:fukui/dinosaur-museum: Inside the vast exhibition hall of the Fukui Prefectural Dinosaur Museum: dozens of complete dinosaur skeleton mounts in ivory and brown tones, a towering long-necked sauropod in the centre, a lifelike dinosaur model on a rocky diorama, small distant visitors, bright even interior light.
s:fukui/eiheiji: Temple halls of Eiheiji with dark tiled roofs connected by long covered wooden stair corridors climbing a forested slope, towering ancient cedars and moss-covered stone lanterns, fresh snow on the roofs and ground, a few small distant monks in black robes, quiet overcast winter light.
s:fukui/tojinbo: Sunset view along the Tojinbo cliffs: rugged dark grey-brown rock formed into tall polygonal columns dropping about twenty metres straight into the Sea of Japan, white waves crashing at the base, the low sun setting over the horizon with golden light on the rock faces.
s:fukui/ichijodani: Reconstructed 16th-century street at the Ichijodani Asakura ruins: low wooden townhouses and samurai residences with board roofs held down by stones, earthen walls and a straight dirt lane, green wooded mountains closing the narrow valley behind, early summer, soft overcast light.
s:fukui/maruoka-castle: Night view of Maruoka Castle in early April: the small original keep with white plaster upper walls over dark wooden lower boards and roofs of grey stone tiles, on a rough stone base atop a low hill, lit softly and framed by illuminated cherry blossoms, a thin mist drifting around it.
s:fukui/mikata-goko: Elevated view from a summit park over the Mikata Five Lakes: interconnected lakes in different shades from deep navy to jade green, separated by forested hills and small villages, Wakasa Bay and the Sea of Japan beyond, clear sunny day with high white clouds.
s:fukui/awara-onsen: Open-air stone bath at a traditional ryokan in Awara Onsen in winter: steaming clear water in a rock-edged pool, a carefully pruned pine and a stone lantern in the garden behind, wooden eaves above, light snow on the rocks, soft dusk light, no people.
f:fukui/echizen-gani: Overhead shot of a whole boiled snow crab on a woven bamboo tray: bright orange-red shell and long spindly legs spread out, a small yellow tag clipped to one leg, a lemon wedge and a small bowl of vinegar beside it, dark wooden table, natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:fukui/oroshi-soba: 45-degree view of Echizen oroshi soba: chilled grey buckwheat noodles in a shallow ceramic bowl with cold broth, topped with a mound of freshly grated white daikon radish, fluttering bonito flakes and chopped green onion, wooden table, soft natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:fukui/sauce-katsudon: 45-degree view of a lidded bowl of Fukui sauce katsudon: three thin pork cutlets in fine golden breadcrumbs, soaked in glossy dark brown sweet Worcestershire-style sauce and laid over white rice, no egg, the lid resting beside it, wooden counter, warm light, shallow depth of field.
f:fukui/saba-heshiko: Close view of thin slices of heshiko fermented mackerel, lightly grilled with charred edges, silvery-brown skin and flecks of rice bran, arranged on a small rustic ceramic plate beside a bowl of white rice and a small cup of sake, dark wood table, natural light, shallow depth of field.
s:yamanashi/chureito: Classic view from the hillside observation deck of Arakurayama Sengen Park in mid-April: the vermilion five-storey Chureito Pagoda surrounded by pale pink cherry blossoms, the town spread below, and snow-capped Mount Fuji rising perfectly symmetrical behind, clear early-morning sky.
s:yamanashi/kawaguchiko-oishi: Early summer morning at Oishi Park on the north shore of Lake Kawaguchi: neat rows of purple lavender in the foreground, the calm blue lake beyond, and Mount Fuji across the water with thin streaks of remaining snow near the summit, soft clear light.
s:yamanashi/oshino-hakkai: Close view across a crystal-clear spring pond at Oshino Hakkai: deep blue-green water so transparent that waving green waterweed and fish are visible on the bottom, old thatched-roof farmhouses beside it, and snow-capped Mount Fuji rising behind, crisp early spring morning.
s:yamanashi/fuji-yoshida-trail: Pre-dawn view from high on Mount Fuji's Yoshida Trail: zigzag switchbacks of reddish-brown volcanic gravel lit by a line of tiny distant headlamps, small mountain huts clinging to the slope, and a vast sea of clouds below glowing orange at the horizon, summer.
s:yamanashi/nenba: Winter view of Saiko Iyashi-no-Sato Nenba after snowfall: a row of traditional farmhouses with thick, steep thatched roofs lining a gentle slope, a small stream and wooden water wheel in front, and snow-covered Mount Fuji visible above the trees, clear blue sky.
s:yamanashi/fuji-shibazakura: Early May view across the Fuji Shibazakura field: vast carpets of pink, magenta, lilac and white moss phlox laid out in flowing geometric patterns, dark green forest beyond, and Mount Fuji with a snowy summit rising behind, bright sunny morning.
s:yamanashi/shosenkyo: Sengataki Falls at the head of Shosenkyo Gorge in November: a white waterfall plunging about thirty metres between pale weathered granite rocks, framed by red, orange and yellow autumn maples and pines, mist rising from the plunge pool, soft overcast light.
s:yamanashi/fuji-q-highland: View of the giant steel roller coaster tracks at Fuji-Q Highland rising and twisting in steep curves and drops, with snow-capped Mount Fuji looming directly behind in a clear winter sky, crisp morning light, tiny distant riders on a train cresting the top.
f:yamanashi/hoto: 45-degree view of hoto in a heavy black iron pot: thick flat wheat noodles simmered in a cloudy miso broth with chunks of orange kabocha pumpkin, napa cabbage, carrot, shiitake and green onion, steam rising, rustic wooden table, warm natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:yamanashi/yoshida-udon: 45-degree view of Yoshida udon: very thick, firm white noodles in a soy and miso broth in a simple bowl, topped with boiled cabbage and slices of simmered meat, a small dish of red chili paste beside it, plain wooden table, natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:yamanashi/shingen-mochi: Overhead shot of shingen mochi on a small square of patterned cloth: soft white rice cake pieces generously dusted with golden roasted soybean flour, dark brown kuromitsu syrup being drizzled over them, a small wooden pick beside it, light wooden table, soft natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:yamanashi/koshu-wine: A glass of pale straw-coloured Koshu white wine on a wooden table at a vineyard, beside a bunch of pinkish-purple Koshu grapes and two ripe peaches, rows of green vines and mountains softly blurred behind, warm late-summer afternoon light, shallow depth of field.
s:nagano/matsumoto-castle: View across the moat of Matsumoto Castle in early April: the black-walled six-storey keep with white upper bands and grey tiled roofs, a small vermilion bridge in front, reflected in still water, cherry blossoms along the bank and the snowy Northern Alps on the horizon, clear morning.
s:nagano/kamikochi: View along the Azusa River at Kamikochi in October: the wooden Kappa-bashi suspension bridge spanning crystal-clear turquoise water over pale stones, golden larches on the banks, and the jagged Hotaka peaks dusted with early snow behind, crisp sunny morning.
s:nagano/jigokudani-monkey: Close view of several Japanese macaques with red faces and thick grey-brown fur sitting in a steaming natural hot spring pool, snowflakes on their heads, deep snow on the surrounding rocks and forested slope, soft grey winter light.
s:nagano/zenkoji: View along the stone-paved approach through the massive two-storey wooden Sanmon gate toward Zenkoji's main hall with its huge sweeping dark cypress-bark roof, a large bronze incense burner with smoke drifting in front, early morning soft light, a few small distant visitors.
s:nagano/tsumago: Eye-level view along the main street of Tsumago-juku: two-storey dark wooden inns and shops with latticed fronts, deep eaves and wooden shutters, no power lines, a gently curving lane with stone gutters, autumn-coloured forested hills behind, soft overcast light.
s:nagano/hakuba: Happo-ike, a small alpine pond on the Happo-one ridge above Hakuba, perfectly mirroring the jagged Hakuba Sanzan peaks still streaked with white snow, rocky shoreline and low alpine shrubs in the foreground, crisp clear early summer morning with a deep blue sky.
s:nagano/karuizawa: A quiet forest lane in Karuizawa in late October lined with tall larch trees glowing golden-yellow, fallen needles covering the path, a small wooden chapel with a steep pointed roof partly visible among the trunks, soft low autumn sunlight filtering through.
s:nagano/nozawa-onsen: Snowy village lane in Nozawa Onsen at dusk: a traditional wooden public bathhouse with a curved temple-style roof and warmly lit windows, steam rising into cold air, deep snow banks lining the narrow street, a few small distant figures in winter coats.
f:nagano/shinshu-soba: Overhead shot of zaru soba: a neat mound of cold, speckled grey-brown buckwheat noodles on a bamboo mat in a square black lacquer tray, a cup of dipping sauce, chopped green onion and a dab of wasabi on small dishes, dark wood table, soft natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:nagano/oyaki: 45-degree view of several round oyaki dumplings with lightly charred golden patches on a woven bamboo tray, one broken open to reveal a filling of chopped dark green pickled nozawana greens, rustic wooden table, warm morning light, shallow depth of field.
f:nagano/sanzokuyaki: 45-degree view of a teishoku tray with sanzokuyaki: a whole large fried chicken thigh with a crisp deep golden-brown crust, sliced across, next to a pile of shredded cabbage and a lemon wedge, with a bowl of rice and miso soup, wooden table, natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:nagano/shinshu-apple: Close view of a shallow wooden crate full of large, glossy red-and-yellow streaked apples at a roadside farm stand in autumn, a few apples with leaves still attached, an orchard softly blurred behind, warm afternoon sunlight, shallow depth of field.
s:gifu/shirakawago: Elevated view from the Ogimachi observation point over Shirakawa-go in winter: dozens of steep A-frame thatched gassho-zukuri farmhouses covered in thick snow, scattered among snowy fields and trees, forested mountains around, warm lights glowing in windows at blue hour.
s:gifu/takayama-sanmachi: Eye-level view down a narrow lane in Takayama's Sanmachi old town in early morning: rows of dark brown wooden merchant houses with fine latticed fronts and low eaves, a ball of dried cedar leaves hanging above a sake brewery entrance, narrow stone gutters, soft light, no crowds.
s:gifu/miyagawa-asaichi: Morning view along the Miyagawa riverside market: a row of simple stalls under canvas awnings displaying fresh vegetables, pickles, apples and handicrafts beneath leafy trees, the clear Miyagawa River alongside, small distant shoppers, soft early light.
s:gifu/hida-furukawa: View along the narrow Seto River canal in Hida-Furukawa: white-walled storehouses with dark wooden lower boards and tiled roofs lining a stone embankment, dozens of red, orange and white koi swimming in the clear water, early summer greenery, soft daylight.
s:gifu/shinhotaka-ropeway: A double-decker cable car gliding along its cables above snow-covered conifer forest, with the jagged, snow-clad peaks of the Hotaka range rising sharply behind under a deep blue winter sky, bright crisp sunlight.
s:gifu/gero-onsen: Evening view along the wide, shallow Hida River at Gero Onsen: multi-storey hotels and ryokan lining the banks with warm lit windows, wisps of steam rising, forested hills behind, calm blue hour light reflected on the water.
s:gifu/gujo-hachiman: Narrow stone-paved lane in Gujo Hachiman beside a clear-water stone channel with carp swimming in it, white plastered walls and old wooden houses alongside, a few red maple leaves overhanging, the small white castle keep visible on the wooded hill above, autumn daylight.
s:gifu/magome: View up the stone-paved sloping street of Magome-juku: two-storey wooden inns and shops with dark timber fronts on both sides, a wooden water wheel turning beside a small stream, potted flowers, autumn-coloured hills beyond, soft afternoon light.
f:gifu/hida-gyu: Close view of Hida beef nigiri: thin slices of richly marbled beef, lightly seared and glistening, topped with a pinch of grated ginger and green onion, each served on a crisp round rice cracker as a plate, wooden counter, warm natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:gifu/takayama-ramen: 45-degree view of a bowl of Takayama ramen: thin curly noodles in a clear, light brown soy broth, topped with slices of pork chashu, bamboo shoots and chopped green onion, simple wooden counter, soft natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:gifu/hoba-miso: 45-degree view of hoba miso: a large dried brown magnolia leaf set on a small tabletop charcoal brazier, bubbling miso with chopped green onion and sliced shiitake on top, a bowl of white rice beside it, tatami room setting, soft morning light, shallow depth of field.
f:gifu/mitarashi-dango: Close view of several skewers of small grilled rice dumplings brushed with glossy soy sauce, with charred brown spots, resting on a small paper-lined tray, an old wooden street stall softly blurred behind, daylight, shallow depth of field.
s:shizuoka/miho-no-matsubara: Clear winter morning on the grey pebble beach of Miho no Matsubara: a long grove of twisted black pines along the shore, gentle waves of Suruga Bay, and snow-capped Mount Fuji rising across the water, soft pastel sky.
s:shizuoka/nihondaira: View from the outer walkway of Nihondaira Yume Terrace: the octagonal building wrapped in fine vertical wooden louvres, a wraparound gallery deck, and beyond it Shimizu Port, Suruga Bay and snow-capped Mount Fuji, clear winter afternoon.
s:shizuoka/fujisan-hongu-sengen: View across the gravel courtyard of Fujisan Hongu Sengen Taisha: the vermilion two-storey main hall with a dark cypress-bark roof, a vermilion tower gate, and snow-capped Mount Fuji rising directly behind against a clear winter sky, bright morning light.
s:shizuoka/shiraito-falls: Shiraito Falls in summer: a wide, curved cliff of dark rock draped with green moss and ferns, with hundreds of fine white threads of spring water streaming down into a clear blue-green pool, mist in the air, soft early-morning light.
s:shizuoka/fujinomiya-trail: View down the Fujinomiya Trail on Mount Fuji in summer: a rocky path of dark volcanic rubble zigzagging down the steep slope past small stone-walled mountain huts, a sea of white clouds below and the Suruga Bay coastline faintly visible, bright morning sun.
s:shizuoka/shuzenji: Late November view along the Katsura River in Shuzenji Onsen: the small rock-built Tokko-no-yu hot spring pavilion in the middle of the shallow river, a red-railed footbridge, traditional wooden inns on the banks, and red and orange maples overhead, soft overcast light.
s:shizuoka/kawazu-sakura: Riverside view along the Kawazu River in mid-February: a long avenue of Kawazu cherry trees in full deep-pink bloom lining both banks, bright yellow rapeseed flowers below them, clear shallow water, small distant walkers, sunny blue sky.
s:shizuoka/atami: Night view over Atami Bay during a summer fireworks show: large golden and white bursts reflected on the dark sea, the curved sandy beach and promenade lights, hillside hotels glowing in the background, clear warm evening.
f:shizuoka/shizuoka-oden: 45-degree view of Shizuoka oden on bamboo skewers in a rectangular pot of dark soy and beef broth: grey black hanpen fishcakes, beef tendon, eggs and daikon, a plate of skewers sprinkled with green aonori and fish powder, retro counter, warm light, shallow depth of field.
f:shizuoka/hamamatsu-unagi: Overhead shot of unaju: glossy, caramelised grilled eel fillets laid over white rice in a red-and-black lacquered box, a small dish of pickles and a bowl of clear eel liver soup beside it, sansho pepper shaker, wooden table, natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:shizuoka/sakura-ebi: 45-degree view of a sakura-ebi kakiage: a crisp, round golden fritter packed with hundreds of tiny translucent pink shrimp, on a bowl of white rice, a small dish of dipping sauce beside it, wooden table at a seaside eatery, natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:shizuoka/shizuoka-tea: Close view of deep-steamed Shizuoka green tea in a small white ceramic cup, the liquor a vivid cloudy jade green, beside a dark clay teapot and a few dry tea leaves, a window behind showing rows of green tea bushes softly blurred, spring daylight, shallow depth of field.
s:aichi/nagoya-castle: View of Nagoya Castle's main keep in early April: white walls, green copper-tiled roofs with ornate gables, and two golden shachihoko ornaments shining at the ridge ends, standing on massive curved stone walls, cherry trees in full bloom in front, clear blue sky.
s:aichi/atsuta-jingu: A wide gravel path through the dense ancient forest of Atsuta Jingu leading to plain unpainted cypress shrine buildings with simple green copper roofs, a massive old camphor tree beside the path, dappled summer sunlight, a few small distant visitors.
s:aichi/osu: View of Osu Kannon's vermilion main hall with a sweeping dark grey tiled roof above wide stone steps, pigeons on the paved forecourt, the entrance of a covered shopping arcade at the edge of the frame, bright daylight, small distant visitors.
s:aichi/toyota-museum: Inside a long red-brick former spinning mill with a sawtooth roof and cast-iron columns: rows of early automatic looms in dark cast iron and polished steel with white cotton threads strung across them, soft daylight from the roof windows, a few small distant visitors.
s:aichi/ghibli-park: A rural 1950s-style Japanese wooden country house with a small attached Western-style wing with white-framed windows, standing among tall trees in a green forest park, a vegetable patch and a well in front, lush summer greenery, soft natural light.
s:aichi/inuyama-castle: View from the opposite bank of the wide Kiso River of Inuyama Castle's small three-storey keep with white walls, dark tiled roofs and curved gables crowning a wooded bluff, cherry trees in bloom along the riverbank, calm water reflections, spring morning.
s:aichi/korankei: Late November view of Korankei Gorge: the vermilion Taigetsu-kyo bridge spanning the shallow Tomoe River, framed by hillsides of blazing red, orange and yellow maples, leaves floating on the clear water, soft overcast light.
s:aichi/tokoname: The Dokan-zaka slope on the Tokoname Pottery Footpath: a narrow lane with retaining walls densely embedded with old brown glazed ceramic pipes and shochu bottles, the ground paved with broken pottery fragments, a tall brick chimney behind, soft afternoon light.
f:aichi/hitsumabushi: Overhead shot of hitsumabushi: a round wooden rice tub filled with chopped, glossy charcoal-grilled eel over rice, a small bowl and a rice paddle, condiments of chopped green onion, shredded nori and wasabi, a small pot of dashi broth, wooden table, natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:aichi/misokatsu: 45-degree view of miso katsu: a sliced golden pork cutlet drenched in thick, glossy dark brown haccho miso sauce, sprinkled with sesame, next to a pile of shredded cabbage, with rice and miso soup, wooden counter, warm light, shallow depth of field.
f:aichi/tebasaki: Close view of a plate piled with Nagoya-style tebasaki chicken wings: crisp, glossy brown skin coated in sweet-savoury glaze, dusted with coarse black pepper and white sesame seeds, a glass of beer blurred behind, izakaya counter, warm light, shallow depth of field.
f:aichi/kishimen: 45-degree view of a bowl of kishimen: wide, flat, glossy white noodles in light brown bonito broth, topped with a heap of dancing bonito flakes, a slice of fried tofu, kamaboko fishcake and green leafy vegetables, simple counter, natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:aichi/morning: 45-degree view of a Nagoya morning set on a retro coffee-shop table: a cup of black coffee, a thick slice of buttered toast spread with sweet red bean paste, and a boiled egg in a small cup, warm window light, shallow depth of field.
